name: Clearance Fit Calculator
blurb: actual clearance or interference of an ISO fit such as H7/g6
intro: Give a nominal size and a fit like H7/g6: it returns the hole and shaft limits from ISO 286-1 and the smallest and largest clearance (or interference) that can occur, with the preferred fits at that size for comparison.

inputs.label: Fit (hole/shaft)
inputs.help: Letters C D E F G H JS K M N P R S (hole) and c-s (shaft), grades 4-12.

examples.title: Ø10 dowel pin press fit H7/p6

usage: Give the nominal size in mm (0-500) and the fit as text 'H7/g6' (hole letter and grade / shaft letter and grade; letters C-S, grades 4-12). It returns the hole and shaft deviations in µm and limits in mm, the minimum and maximum clearance in µm (negative = interference), the fit type, and a table of the preferred hole-basis fits at that size. Use it to choose or check a fit for a shaft, pin or bearing seat.
sources: ISO 286-1:2010 tables 1-3 (IT grades, fundamental deviations) and clause 5.3 (hole deviations: general rule and Δ rule)
ISO 286-2 / Machinery's Handbook preferred fits (H11/c11 … H7/s6)
